summary: Martin Marietta Materials filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $1.5 billion five-year senior unsecured revolving credit facility with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent, replacing its existing credit agreement. The facility matures August 18, 2031, with ratings-based pricing and a maximum leverage ratio covenant of 3.75:1, with temporary increases to 4.75:1 following the previously announced Lhoist North America acquisition. No borrowings were outstanding under the prior facility. This is a routine financing event, not a special situation.
